name: Yannick Tofauti-Szarvásy
role: Numbers runner and bookmaker's legman for a sports and events gambling operation in Shallowgrave
location: Shallowgrave — covers a circuit from Copperhead Market to the Brewer's Spine canal walkway, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Yannick is a compact, quick-moving young man with warm dark brown skin, a gap-toothed smile he deploys constantly, and hair grown out into a high puff that he dyes a different color every two weeks — currently a deep auburn. His ears have cat-ear geneware tips that he got on his seventeenth birthday as a rite of passage in his friend group, and he has a small luminescent dot above his left eyebrow like a permanent beauty mark. He dresses in layers of cheap, colorful synthetics and always has at least four devices in different pockets, each running a different channel.

Yannick is relentlessly cheerful in the way that only very fast people can afford to be — he knows he can get out of most situations before they turn bad, and that confidence reads as ease. He's sharper than anyone gives him credit for, can hold several hundred bets in active mental accounting at any given moment, and has an intuitive read on crowd psychology that his bosses haven't fully noticed yet. He thinks he's working toward something, building toward running his own book, but he hasn't articulated to himself that the organization he works for rarely promotes from his position.

core_fears: being still — that if he stops moving, something will catch up with him that he can't outrun
that the people he works for see him as permanently disposable
core_desires: respect from people he respects — to be seen as smart, not just fast
his own book, his own operation, something that's his
coping_mechanisms: constant motion and social engagement that keeps him from thinking too hard
humor as deflection for anything that genuinely worries him
blind_spots: doesn't recognize exploitative structures when they feel comfortable
overestimates how much his bosses like him
psychology.secret: He's been quietly skimming — not money, but information. He keeps a private log of patterns he's noticed in the bets: who bets big before certain outcomes, who seems to know things before they happen. He doesn't know what to do with it yet but he knows it's worth something.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Shallowgrave slang heavy, numerical shorthand, sports metaphors, moves faster than his grammar
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid-fire with sudden full stops when something actually interests him
verbal_tics: gives everyone a number-based nickname without explaining why
example_lines: Yeah yeah yeah, Eleven Houses pays clean, you know that — when's the last time Adaugo shorted someone? Don't answer that, it's rhetorical, she hasn't, she won't.
You want to put Φ40 on the Ferrogate Cup semifinal? Bold. Very bold. I respect the boldness. I don't respect the odds you're working with but I respect the boldness.

story_hooks: Yannick's private betting log has recorded a clear pattern of insider manipulation — someone is fixing events and he needs help understanding what he has before bringing it to anyone
He witnessed something on his circuit that he passed off as nothing but players quickly realize was significant — getting him to recall the details requires earning his trust
He comes to players because a client on his circuit has stopped paying and is making threats, and Yannick is not authorized to escalate to his bosses without losing face
narrative_function: Street-level information conduit — knows everyone on his circuit and their business; introduces players to the Shallowgrave social fabric; potential vulnerability in a larger criminal operation; could be a witness to something he doesn't realize he saw.
augmentations: Cat-ear geneware (cosmetic, tips only). Bioluminescent beauty-mark dot above left eyebrow. Standard cheap retinal display — second-hand Tessera model, consumer grade.
daily_life: Wakes late, picks up the day's numbers from a deadrop near Brewer's Spine at noon, runs his circuit through Shallowgrave and Copperhead Market for six hours collecting slips and settling wins, spends evenings at the social club watching whatever sporting event the bets are riding on.
affiliation: Legman for a bookmaking operation called the Eleven Houses, run by an older fixer named Adaugo Ferraro-Tchamba who operates out of a private room at the Copperhead Market social club

decision_rules: Keep moving — standing still is how you get cornered
Never extend credit without authorization — that's above his pay grade and he knows it
Laugh first at anything that might be a threat — disarms most situations
escalation_ladder: Promise to check with his boss, then doesn't come back alone
Call in a favor from someone bigger on his circuit
Run and report up the chain
Only as absolute last resort, the knife he keeps in his left jacket pocket — he's never used it

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately friendly and very slightly performing — charm as default setting
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely warm, extremely loyal, will share food and money without thinking about it

stress_responses.low: Jokes increase in frequency and quality
stress_responses.medium: Starts physically moving around the space, can't be still
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet and small — the energy collapses inward

contradictions: Reads people with startling precision but refuses to apply that skill to understanding his own situation
Values loyalty deeply while working in a field where loyalty is transactional
habits: Counts things constantly — steps, tiles, people in a room
Leaves an E.L.F. offering at the Brewer's Spine canal shrine every morning — a single bet slip, win or lose
breaking_points: Discovering Adaugo Ferraro-Tchamba has been setting him up as a fall guy
Someone on his circuit being hurt because of a bet he ran

related_entities: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.build: Compact and wiry with minimal bulk — built for speed and agility rather than strength. Fast-twitch muscle definition visible in forearms and calves from constant circuit-running.
physical_description.hair_color: Deep auburn (dyed; natural color dark brown)
physical_description.hair_style: High, voluminous puff with careful maintenance and deliberate styling
physical_description.eye_color: Warm dark brown with faint amber retinal display overlay visible when active
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm dark brown with even undertone
physical_description.complexion: Clear, youthful skin with good definition in cheekbones and jaw. Gap between front incisors visible when smiling — a signature feature he uses often and without self-consciousness. Minimal facial hair.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent dot above left eyebrow, soft pale blue-white glow, approximately 3mm diameter — appears intentional and maintained
Cat-ear geneware tips protruding from upper ear cartilage, tapered points with slight iridescent sheen, suggesting recent or well-maintained modification
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent beauty mark above left eyebrow (pale blue-white, soft glow). Feline ear geneware tips (cosmetic mod, iridescent finish). Retinal display hardware visible as faint amber grid pattern across pupils when eyes catch light or system is active — second-hand Tessera consumer model, noticeable if you know what to look for.
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually in motion even when standing still — weight shifted to balls of feet, fidgeting hands, constant low-level kinetic energy. Moves through crowds with practiced efficiency, sliding rather than pushing. Carries himself with the ease of someone who knows he can escape any situation. Smiles constantly — gap-toothed grin deployed as a social tool.
physical_description.clothing_style: Layered cheap synthetic textiles in bright, clashing colors — neon greens, hot pinks, electric blues worn together without coordination concerns. Oversized hoodies and fitted tank tops layered underneath. At least four visible pockets, all occupied with different devices (phones, betting slips, comms units). Worn synthleather sneakers, scuffed but functional. Tier 4 working-class aesthetic with intentional color choices that read as young and confident rather than poor.
